ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota fraud cases
ideas.description: An investigation into Minnesota fraud cases, including financial and grant-related fraud, and their connection to Congress.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
How are the cases connected to Congress?
ideas.insight: This investigation could uncover a larger pattern of fraud and potentially lead to policy changes.

ideas.title: Impact of child care funding freeze
ideas.description: An investigation into the impact of the child care funding freeze on families and states, including Minnesota, Colorado, and Illinois.
questions: What is the impact on families?
How are states responding to the freeze?
ideas.insight: This investigation could highlight the effects of policy changes on vulnerable populations.
